terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: Welcome to Pinksea. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to the following terms:<title>1. Eligibility</title>You must be at least 18 years old to use this service. By using the platform, you confirm you are of legal age in your jurisdiction.<title>2. Content</title>All content is fictional and generated by artificial intelligence created and maintained by Pinksea. Any resemblance to real individuals is purely coincidental.<title>3. Subscription and Payments</title>- Access to content requires an active monthly subscription.- All sales are final. No refunds will be provided under any circumstances.- Optional tips can be sent to the AI creator. These are also non-refundable.<title>4. Ownership</title>All content and revenue remain the sole property of Pinksea. Users receive no ownership or licensing rights by subscribing.<title>5. User Conduct</title>Users may not:- Share, reproduce, or distribute content from the platform.- Attempt to impersonate or contact the AI creator.- Violate any applicable laws while using the platform.<title>6. Limitation of Liability</title>The service is provided “as is” without warranties. Pinksea is not liable for any damages resulting from use of the platform.<title>7. Modifications</title>Terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance.<title>8. Contact</title>For any questions, contact: admin@pinksea.me

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Pinksea is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.<title>1. Information We Collect</title>We may collect:- Email address (if provided)- Payment information (processed by third-party providers)- Usage data (pages viewed, time spent, etc.) We do not collect personal chats or messages, as no messaging exists on the platform.<title>2. How We Use Information</title>- To deliver purchased content- To process payments- To improve our services- To comply with legal obligations<title>3. Sharing of Information</title>We do not sell your data. We may share it with:- Payment processors- Analytics providers- Legal authorities if required<title>4. Data Security</title>We use reasonable measures to protect your data. However, no system is 100% secure.<title>5. Your Rights</title>Depending on your location, you may have rights to:- Access your data- Delete your data- Correct inaccurate data Contact us to make a request: admin@pinksea.me<title>6. Cookies</title>We may use cookies to improve functionality and analyze usage.<title>7. Changes to This Policy</title>We may update this policy at any time. Continued use of the service means you accept the changes.<title>8. Contact</title>For privacy concerns, email: admin@pinksea.me
